description: This file contains classes for interacting with MongoDB collections related to manufacturing defect management. Specifically, it defines repositories for 'defect_types' and 'defects' collections, providing methods for listing, inserting, updating, and querying documents.

classes.name: DefectTypesRepository
classes.description: Repository for managing defect types in the MongoDB 'defect_types' collection.

classes.name: DefectsRepository
classes.description: Repository for managing defects in the MongoDB 'defects' collection.

methods.name: DefectTypesRepository.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the repository and sets the MongoDB collection for defect types.

methods.name: DefectTypesRepository.list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of active defect types, sorted by name.

methods.name: DefectTypesRepository.upsert
methods.description: Inserts or updates a defect type document based on the code.

methods.name: DefectTypesRepository.find_by_id
methods.description: Finds a defect type document by its ID.

methods.name: DefectsRepository.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the repository and sets the MongoDB collection for defects.

methods.name: DefectsRepository.insert
methods.description: Inserts a new defect document into the collection.

methods.name: DefectsRepository.list
methods.description: Lists defects matching filters with pagination.

methods.name: DefectsRepository.count
methods.description: Counts the number of defect documents matching filters.

methods.name: DefectsRepository.find_by_id
methods.description: Finds a defect document by its ID.

methods.name: DefectsRepository.update_fields
methods.description: Updates specific fields of a defect document.

methods.name: list[dict] list(self, filters: dict[str, Any], limit: int, skip: int)
dict upsert(self, code: str, name: str, description: Optional[str], is_active: bool)
